notes: All-new sound: alert chimes, keyboard taps, phone ring, coffee, office ambience with rain on night shifts, and generative music that intensifies during major incidents.
Separate volume sliders for Effects, Ambience and Music in Settings.
Send feedback: report bugs or suggest ideas from Settings, with screenshots or screen recordings.

Leaderboards open smoothly without loading twice.
